ligand_universe.primary: unique source/from genes in NicheNet lr_network_human_21122021.rds
ligand_universe.policy: retain the complete NicheNet ligand universe regardless of hUC-MSC or PE expression; annotate but do not filter using OmniPath

baseline_processing.input: true Cell Ranger sparse raw count matrices
baseline_processing.gene_symbol_collapse: sum feature rows sharing the same non-empty gene symbol before donor summaries

baseline_detection.MULTIDATASET_LOW_EXPRESSION: not robust; donor_low_detected in at least one donor of each core dataset
baseline_detection.DATASET_SPECIFIC: donor_supported in at least two donors of exactly one core dataset and no donor_low_detected evidence in the other
baseline_detection.DONOR_VARIABLE: donor_supported in at least two donors overall but no earlier class applies
baseline_detection.donor_variable_flag: within either core dataset, expressing-fraction range >=0.25 or ligand-rank IQR >=0.20

licensing_processing.cell_summary: condition pseudobulk CPM and fraction of cells with count >0
licensing_processing.donor_summary: Donor1 P5 effect; Donor2 median of P2 and P5 effects

licensing_classification.PASSAGE_DEPENDENT: Donor2 P2/P5 effects have opposite signs with max absolute effect >=0.5, or their absolute difference >=1.0
licensing_classification.DONOR_DEPENDENT: not passage-dependent; donor-level effects have opposite signs and max absolute effect >=0.5
licensing_classification.LICENSING_CONSISTENT_UP: not passage/donor-dependent; both donor effects >=0.5 and all three stratum effects >0
licensing_classification.LICENSING_CONSISTENT_DOWN: not passage/donor-dependent; both donor effects <=-0.5 and all three stratum effects <0

licensing_programs.resource: MSigDB 2026.1.Hs Hallmark, Reactome and GO Biological Process
licensing_programs.method: cameraPR on the mean of two donor-level ligand-independent gene effects; inter-gene correlation 0.01
licensing_programs.consistency: full-family BH FDR <0.05, same program direction in both donors, and same Donor2 P2/P5 program direction
licensing_programs.label: HUCMSC_LICENSING_PROGRAM_NOT_PE_THERAPEUTIC_PROGRAM

sender_hierarchy.S1: ROBUST_BASELINE_SENDER plus LICENSING_CONSISTENT_UP or DOWN plus retained expression after stimulation in both donors
sender_hierarchy.S2: ROBUST_BASELINE_SENDER not meeting S1; includes constitutive and variable licensing responses
sender_hierarchy.S3: MULTIDATASET_LOW_EXPRESSION, DATASET_SPECIFIC or DONOR_VARIABLE baseline evidence
sender_hierarchy.phase4_candidates: S1 and S2 only; label HIGH_CONFIDENCE_SENDER_CANDIDATE, never therapeutic
sender_hierarchy.candidate_order: S1 before S2; then descending supported baseline donor count, descending minimum of the two dataset median rank percentiles, descending absolute median licensing donor effect, then gene symbol

source_context.method: GSE182158 donor-level ligand rank percentiles; descriptive median UC minus median non-UC MSC rank
source_context.interpretation: protocol/tissue/source context only; never a causal UC-origin effect and never required for baseline robustness

gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE4: at least 3 independent licensing donors, at least 25 S1 and at least 75 S1+S2 candidates, no critical data-layer risk
gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE4_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: six usable baseline donors across two datasets, both licensing donors usable, at least 25 S1+S2 candidates, no critical data-layer risk
gate_rule.REVISE_SENDER_FRAMEWORK: 10 to 24 S1+S2 candidates or one core data arm not fully usable
gate_rule.NO_GO_SENDER_ARM: fewer than 10 S1+S2 candidates or donor identity/data layer invalid
